summary: Security concerns around Claude Code extensions and DeepSeek's usage in government systems are prominent. New open-source tools for agent sandboxing, memory, and workflow management are emerging. Several platforms are enhancing their agent capabilities, with a focus on local execution and cost reduction. | Vendor-run updates: multiple vendor product releases (AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Cloudflare GA, Cursor SDK, Microsoft Foundry), several GHSA security advisories (MCP, mem0), and infra/sandbox product moves (Modal, E2B, Supabase). | GitHub OSS snapshot: multiple vendor releases (Microsoft, Anthropic, Google, Vercel, Cloudflare) plus many single-repo agent infra projects. No social/operator discussion sources in this shard — user-workflow signals are missing. | Package-layer sweep: official OpenAI/npm release, Amazon ECS image, high-download VS Code agent, and multiple agent sandboxes/detection tools; missing social operator reports.
